banner: Paid and Organic Social Media Strategy

about.caption: Meghan Blackford, Owner
about.paragraph1: True to our namesake, we know how to build buzz around brands, services and special events, and keep the conversation going with the right people.
about.paragraph2: Social media moves quickly, as do we. 99 percent of the time, what worked last year – or last month – will yield less effective results in today’s marketplace. For this reason, we continually test ideas, refine messaging and explore new audiences to spark curiosity and cultivate new relationships.
about.photoAlt: Meghan Blackford, owner of Social Butterfly Communications
about.paragraph3: We tailor our social media services to your goals, whether you need a single campaign or someone to manage and grow your community. From strategy and copywriting to paid advertising, we execute content that gives people a reason to stop scrolling, get curious and take action.

services.title: Strategy + Development
services.tagline: Refine your messaging and test new audiences.
services.body: We analyze your competitors and refine your brand positioning to clarify what sets your business apart. Then we build a comprehensive social media plan that outlines content strategy and advertising to reach and engage prospective customers.

services.title: Creation + Execution
services.tagline: Bring your brand to life with a social media presence that stands out.
services.body: We create compelling graphics, videos and copy that capture your brand’s personality with clear calls-to-action. Then, we handle scheduling, publishing and community engagement to keep the conversation flowing.

services.title: Advertising + Insights
services.tagline: Optimize content performance to spark a connection with prospective customers.
services.body: Turn interest into action with targeted social advertising. We develop creative, manage campaigns and track performance, optimize your budget and support your business goals.

approach.paragraph1: We build social media plans from the ground up, starting with your business goals. Through research and analysis, we identify what sets your brand apart and develop a content strategy to communicate your value with clarity and purpose.
approach.paragraph2: Compelling content needs to reach the right people. We use demographics, customer and engagement data to build and test audiences more likely to connect with your brand.
approach.paragraph3: Then we test messaging, track performance and refine your campaigns based on what resonates. Discovery, creativity and ongoing optimization guide our approach, helping your social media evolve alongside your business.
